prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, targeted revision of provided remote desktop application concept.
The user LIKES the provided previous concept's desktop layout, device selection and dark mint identity, and explicitly wants MORE GLASS: transparency, backdrop blur and dimensional layering. They rejected a simplified single-list design for lacking tabs. Restore and retain THIS provided topology, but add clearly visible navigation tabs and beautiful rich glass materials. Do NOT simplify to a launcher. Do NOT make matte opaque cards. One polished 1536x1024 landscape presentation with desktop app on left 72% and Android app on right 24%. Caption outside «Асси / стекло и вкладки», small footnote «Визуальная концепция · демоданные». App text in clear accurate Russian. This is a visual concept for a universal remote access utility used by ordinary people AND IT specialists, not a family help app.

Preserve from reference: mint two-stroke logo and «асси» wordmark; dark graphite colors with cool mint accents; desktop grouped list of devices on left; selected laptop in central workspace; «Подключиться» and «Передать файлы» actions; bottom own-code strip; Android device list. Preserve these data labels: «MacBook Pro», «Домашний ПК», «Pixel 9», «Офисный ПК», «Рабочая станция», «Личные», «Рабочие», «В сети», «Не в сети», «Ваш код», «584 209 176», «Предоставить доступ».

NEW NAVIGATION:
Below the slim desktop window title bar add an unmistakable horizontal TAB BAR across main width with four large readable tabs: «Устройства» selected, «Сеансы», «История», «Настройки». Use tab labels plus small consistent line icons. Active tab is pale mint on a frosted raised rounded rectangular pill, other tabs remain quiet translucent surfaces. Tabs must look like clickable product navigation, not small captions. Title bar has brand left and broad field «Имя устройства или код», no extra theme button needed.
Android must show four persistent bottom navigation destinations with icon and text: «Устройства», «Сеансы», «История», «Настройки». First selected in mint frosted capsule. This navigation is essential and must not be omitted or cropped.

GLASS MATERIAL (most important visual change):
The app floats in front of a sophisticated DARK TEAL/MIDNIGHT abstract wallpaper with broad softly lit organic folds. This wallpaper exists visibly BEHIND the window and phone UI so frosted transparency has actual scene information to refract. Desktop sidebar, header/tab strip, bottom utility bar and selected-device card are translucent smoked glass; shapes behind are visibly defocused through them, not plain gradients painted on opaque panels. Controlled thin bright rim highlights, small top-edge reflections, subtle inner highlights and soft cast shadows between layers. Premium restrained lens-like corner refraction only at outer glass edges. A slightly clearer raised active tab and mint translucent main button. Perceivable depth, frosted materials and real optical richness, no heavy chrome border, no neon halo, no rainbow iridescence, no arbitrary shiny blobs. Content-bearing text regions maintain deep local contrast and readable white text. Blur is in the material, never in text or icons. Like exceptionally crafted modern native desktop glass, distinctive and luxurious but calm.

DESKTOP topology:
Compact window title bar, then 4-tab navigation bar.
Left vertical device list below tabs, about 25% of app content width, with groups «Личные», «Рабочие». Selected MacBook row subtly mint tinted. Icon and status dot for each device. Bottom small «Добавить устройство».
Main pane about 75%, selected device heading «MacBook Pro», smaller «macOS · Личные», status «В сети». Modest rendered laptop with dark teal wallpaper in center, not giant; two actions beneath: mint «Подключиться», translucent «Передать файлы». Below it at most ONE quiet line for device details such as «Доступ с подтверждением». REMOVE duplicate recent-device list to avoid overload while retaining full app structure. Let these regions breathe. Footer utility strip «Ваш код 584 209 176», copy button, «Предоставить доступ». NO permanent consent checkbox. The wallpaper laptop is an illustration of the device, not a claim of a live remote screen.

ANDROID:
Header «асси», search «Имя устройства или код», compact filters «Все», «Личные», «Рабочие». Exactly 3 elegant glass rows for MacBook Pro/macOS online, Офисный ПК/Windows online, Pixel 9/Android offline, small appropriate icons and right connect arrows. Bottom own-code area «Ваш код 584 209 176», copy icon, «Предоставить доступ». Then the essential 4-tab navigation above Android gesture bar. Background wallpaper glimpsed and blurred behind smoked translucent panels; legible text. No giant illustration on mobile.

Make this visibly a refinement of the referenced previous design, not a new layout. Outstanding optical craft, balanced information density, realistic native control sizes, crisp typography, straightforward functionality. No marketing slogan, no family avatars, no analytics, no decorative metric cards. All FOUR TABS must be clearly present on BOTH desktop and Android.
